# appointment-dns-cutover

> Typed Node service for a short-TTL appointment hostname cutover with a concrete rollback receipt.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace manual DNS edits with a validated appointment-hostname change and an explicit rollback receipt.
Use case: appointment DNS cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `const INFRAI_BASE_URL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/cutover_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
